layers.note: A shrub of stream banks, lake shores, swamp edges and wet thickets.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 900 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on flats and gentle slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Grows in sun or part shade.
